failure_action: retain the pilot as negative strong-baseline evidence and do not spend full102 budget
full_matrix_action: expand a candidate to all 102 frozen seed7 scenarios only if every check passes
oriented_metric_rule: higher is better except lower unknown_fpr95 is better

required_checks_per_candidate.known_f1_tolerance: mean candidate-minus-OpenDetect Known F1 >= -0.03 and worst scenario >= -0.10
required_checks_per_candidate.metric_breadth: candidate has positive oriented mean gain over OpenDetect on at least 2 of 4 metrics
required_checks_per_candidate.overall_gain: candidate four-metric oriented mean gain over OpenDetect is strictly positive
required_checks_per_candidate.split_and_leakage_integrity: candidate, source MLP, and OpenDetect splits match; no unknown/test fitting
required_checks_per_candidate.suite_robustness: at least 4 of 7 suites are nonnegative and worst suite >= -0.05
required_checks_per_candidate.top_two_rank: candidate four-unknown-metric mean rank among candidates plus OpenDetect <= 2.0
